awakening.prompt: Use case: animation sprite sheet, new character actions. The supplied image is Fenris's APPROVED standing idle pose, the final pose to match. Create EIGHT successive poses of a natural awakening: SLEEPING -> SITTING ON GROUND -> STANDING. Exactly 4 columns x 2 rows, equal 512x640 cells conceptually, read left-to-right top then bottom. The SAME full-size adult character at IDENTICAL anatomical scale throughout; camera and ground line fixed. Never enlarge the lying or sitting poses to fill a cell: a curled sleeping pose is only about one-third of standing height, sitting about two-thirds. All poses in consistent left-facing three-quarter side view like reference. Frame1: fully asleep on his side on the ground, curled comfortably, head resting on forearm, eyes CLOSED, knees bent, bushy tail around legs. Frame2: just waking, eyes half open, head lifted and one hand planted to brace, torso still low. Frame3: pushes upper body up using supporting arm, hips stay on ground, legs unfold into seated pose. Frame4: settled seated ON GROUND, both knees bent loosely, upright slightly relaxed torso, hands resting beside thighs, eyes open, facing left. Frame5: leans forward from seated position, plants one foot and a supporting hand to rise. Frame6: crouched low on both feet, hips lifted, bent knees, hand still bracing near ground. Frame7: nearly upright, knees straightening, hand leaves ground, arms settling. Frame8: EXACT standing idle stance of reference: upright broad muscular torso, legs planted, hands lowered, head facing left. Maintain identical white-grey fur design, cyan irises ONLY inside eyes, clean grey closed muzzle no lipstick, modest wolf ears, brown ragged shorts, short bushy tail, clawed hands and digitigrade feet. No clothing changes, extra accessories, bedding, chair, props, floor, cast shadows, labels, numbering or text. Transparent background with actual alpha. Preserve detailed crisp pixel-art rendering and dark outlines of reference. Proper anatomy in every intermediate pose: exactly two arms, two legs, one tail, consistent face, natural weight support. Same root position and ground contact line within each cell; hips roughly centered in the cell even while curled. Generous margins; all body parts fit. This is a single smooth progression, not eight unrelated poses, and frame1, frame4, frame8 are the stable sleep, seated, standing endpoints.

sleep.prompt: Edit target: approved curled sleeping Fenris sprite. Create a FOUR-frame sleeping BREATHING LOOP, 2 columns x 2 rows, evenly spaced equal cells, true transparent background. Preserve the exact sleeping pose and character design: white-grey adult muscular wolf on his side, head resting on forearm toward left, eyes closed, legs tucked, short bushy tail wrapped by feet, brown ragged shorts. Only a VERY SMALL chest/flank breathing motion: frame1 resting exhale, frame2 slight expansion, frame3 peak inhale (only 2-3 pixels at a 400px wide sprite), frame4 settling toward frame1. Keep head/ears/muzzle, closed eyes, hands, legs, tail tip and ground contact at exactly stable positions. No blinking, no waking, no limb repositioning, no floating. Same proportions, exact fur colours, crisp fine pixel art and outlines. Frame1 must be essentially identical to input. Match scale consistently across all 4 frames, generous empty margins. No floor/shadows, text or labels, props, bedding or other characters.

sit.prompt: Edit target: approved ground-seated Fenris sprite. Create a FOUR-frame calm SITTING BREATHING LOOP, 2 columns x 2 rows, evenly spaced equal cells, true transparent background. Preserve the exact seated pose and character design: upright relaxed white-grey muscular wolf sitting on the ground with legs loosely folded, hands resting by thighs, facing left three-quarter, cyan iris only in actual eye, plain closed muzzle, brown ragged shorts, compact bushy tail tucked to right. Only a VERY SMALL chest and shoulder breathing motion: frame1 resting exhale, frame2 slight chest expansion, frame3 peak inhale with shoulders only 2-3 pixels higher at 350px sprite height, frame4 settling. Keep hips, hands, paws and tail grounded; no hand gestures, nodding, posture changes, standing, perspective changes or extra accessories. Preserve exact face, fur pattern, proportions, fine pixel-art rendering and outlines. Frame1 must be essentially identical to input. Equal scale across all frames, generous transparent margins. No chair, ground/shadows, text or labels.
